request.query: If δ ≥ 0 and 3 ≤ δ^2 log q for a natural q, then 4 < q^(δ*r)

items.name: Int.lt_zpow_iff_log_lt
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semifield R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] [inst_3 : FloorSemiring R]
  {b : ℕ}, 1 < b → ∀ {x : ℤ} {r : R}, 0 < r → (r < ↑b ^ x ↔ Int.log b r < x)

items.name: Int.self_le_zpow_clog
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semifield R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] [inst_3 : FloorSemiring R]
  {b : ℕ}, 1 < b → ∀ (r : R), r ≤ ↑b ^ Int.clog b r

items.name: Int.zpow_log_le_self
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semifield R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] [inst_3 : FloorSemiring R]
  {b : ℕ} {r : R}, 1 < b → 0 < r → ↑b ^ Int.log b r ≤ r

items.name: Int.zpow_le_iff_le_log
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semifield R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] [inst_3 : FloorSemiring R]
  {b : ℕ}, 1 < b → ∀ {x : ℤ} {r : R}, 0 < r → (↑b ^ x ≤ r ↔ x ≤ Int.log b r)

items.name: Int.lt_zpow_succ_log_self
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semifield R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] [inst_3 : FloorSemiring R]
  {b : ℕ}, 1 < b → ∀ (r : R), r < ↑b ^ (Int.log b r + 1)
